live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-20: borg-reborn-rs owner ("yes do all that", filed as #535); zoo owner, 2026-11-20: "do as advised" (a pilot only, all classes; small and medium wait for the gate and the owner).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-20, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#535; supersedes #511's open part, whose pilot
ran the older 78b8f297). Pilot (RULES 16); small + medium after the gate and the owner. Five arms, 18 starts each
(90 games), all classes. An empty override is "all on" here, so alloff is written out and every single-switch arm
sets the other two to 0.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's three values in params-core.json (allon: all 1); every cell ends in
death, turn_cap or borg_stopped (stalls, timeouts and crashes kept apart); frozen-turn bursts classified.
Report per arm and per class: deaths and causes, CL at death, final and maximum level, deepest level; paired
rescued and newly killed against alloff (exact McNemar), identical plays, and for every discordant start the first
divergent action. caution_winning_fight is a parameter for town attacks too (owner, 2026-11-20): count its attack
and refusal notes in town and in the dungeon separately, and say whether a town death or a town attack changed in
the fight and allon arms. Descriptive (RULES 14).
